labels: a photo of a leaf with holes chewed in it
a photo of a green leaf eaten by insects
a photo of a damaged leaf up close
negative_labels: a photo of an empty room

prompt: Find the first bird awake and record it. Then say out loud which direction it is coming from.

rubric.ideal: A robin is singing from the top of the fence and a crow keeps answering it from further off.
The loud one is behind me and to the left, high up in the tree by the road.
Nothing else is awake yet; no cars, no voices, just the one bird and some wind.

prompt: Point the camera straight up. Whatever the sky is doing, it will not be doing it in ten minutes.

labels: a photo of clouds seen from below
a photo of an overcast grey sky
negative_labels: a screenshot of a weather app
a photo of an indoor room

prompt: Find water that is moving without your help. A gutter counts; a puddle with wind on it counts.

labels: a photo of running water outdoors
a photo of a stream of water
a photo of rain water flowing along a curb
negative_labels: a photo of a kitchen sink

prompt: It is raining. Record thirty seconds of it, then say what the rain is landing on.

rubric.ideal: The rain is hitting a metal gutter and a plastic bin lid, so it sounds like two different rains at once.
It comes in bursts; heavy for a few seconds, then almost nothing, then heavy again.

prompt: Get far enough into trees that you cannot see out of them, then photograph what is above your head.

labels: a photo of a tree canopy seen from below
a photo of branches and leaves against the sky
a photo of the inside of a wood looking upwards
negative_labels: a photo of a single houseplant indoors
a photo of an open field with no trees

prompt: Stand next to moving water and say out loud what it sounds like without using the word water.

rubric.ideal: It is a constant hiss with a heavier knocking underneath it where the current hits the stones.
I am getting through this without saying the obvious word; I am calling it the rush, the pouring, the thing going over the edge.
Behind it there is wind in the reeds and a duck complaining about something further along.
